title: Enforce open-session invariant for scene writes
description: Review finding from loreweaver-niw. Scene APIs and schema allow scenes and scene logs for nonexistent or closed sessions, which can break session close and resume invariants. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: openScene and appendSceneLog reject missing or closed sessions; schema or tests enforce scene/log ownership by campaign_session; existing tests are updated to create valid sessions.
notes: Fix: requireOpenSession() guard in openScene + appendSceneLog. RED proven by 18 cross-file failures when guard added (scene tests lacked sessions). GREEN: updated 5 test files to start valid sessions + 3 new rejection tests; 203 pass.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #20 (merged) — requireOpenSession guard on scene writes
